Checks if two planes are parallel within an angle tolerance.

**Panel:** Comma → Util · **Nickname:** `PlParallel?`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Plane A | `A` | Plane | Item |  | First plane. |
| Plane B | `B` | Plane | Item |  | Second plane. |
| Angle Tolerance | `ATol` | Number | Item | `RhinoDoc.ActiveDoc?.ModelAngleToleranceDegrees?? 1.0` | Angular tolerance in degrees (°) |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Relation | `R` | Integer | Item | 1 = parallel & co-directional, -1 = parallel but opposite, 0 = not parallel. |
